execution.timing_scope: Final resumed invocation only; not total fresh-training process sum or campaign wall time.

optimizer_coverage.scope: Exact metadata comparison to SHA-pinned actual own early checkpoint; step values checked separately at full budget

optional_reference_state.scope: post-training only; no reference was used for initialization or continuation

historical_loss_comparison.unit_note: FNO2D compares two original-unit losses per epoch, with divisor 1 for both fields: 500 epochs x 2 = 1,000 comparisons. No UNO /20 conversion is applied.

metadata_errata.source_value: UNO saved per-trajectory 20-step mean /20; unit conversion, not recovery of unsaved sum/(1000*20) rounding. Only one original UNO scientific loss per epoch is counted.
metadata_errata.corrected_value: FNO2D compares two original-unit losses per epoch, with divisor 1 for both fields: 500 epochs x 2 = 1,000 comparisons. No UNO /20 conversion is applied.
metadata_errata.scope: Explanatory text only; all comparison rows, numeric summaries and acceptance statuses unchanged. Original SHA-bound audit retained.

packaging_scope: Existing SHA-bound CPU audit JSON only. All 500x2 scalar rows, own and requested reference state/normalizer comparisons retained. No data/PT/source/model import or new scientific verification. No private paths/run/device UUIDs distributed.
